title: MARQAD PA MAA KI ZAINAB FARYAAD KAR RAHI HAI AMMATERI KAMAAI JANGAL ME LUT GAYI HAI
body:
Ummat ne Mustafa ki loota hai chain Tera
Maara Gaya hai Pyaasa Amma Hussain Tera
Dil baith sa gaya hai ankhon me teergi hai
<<MINI>>
Ammateri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Teero'n se hogaya hai Qasim ka Jism chhalni
Magtal ki zulmato'n me Dulhan ki maang ujdi
Sehre ki har ladi se hasrat baras rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Ammateri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Barchhi jigar pa kha kar Akbar ki Naojawaani
Mitti me milgayi hai Laila ki Zindagani
Bete ko yaad karke Maadar tadap rahi hai
<<MINI>>
Ammateri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaado'n se khelti hain Besheer ki Adaaein
Reh reh ke derahi hai Asghar ko Maa Sadaaein
Jhoole ki khaamoshi par khud mout rorahi hai
<<MINI>>
AmmatTeri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maare gaye hain pyaase AmmaMerePisar bhi
Daste laee'n ne kardi aaghosh Meri sooni
Duniya Meri nazar me taareek hogayi hai
<<MINI>>
Ammateri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankhon me basgaye hain zindaan ke andhere
Yaade Sakina Amma rehti hai Mujhko ghere
Baba ko rote rote Masoom chal basi hai
<<MINI>>
Ammateri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid ki Pusht par hain durro'n ke neel ab bhi
Amma rula gayi hai Mazloom ki Aseeri
Chhaale hain dasto pa me Bimar par ghashi hai
<<MINI>>
AmmatTeri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ko raas Amma Karbobala na aaya
Chheena hai Mere Sar se do Bhaiyo'n ka Saaya
Ab to Duwaaein Zainab marne ki Maangti hai
<<MINI>>
AmmaTeri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
In baazuo'n ke Tujhko daaghe rasan dikhaane
Aayi hai Teri Beti rudaade Gham Sunaane
Kurta kahin jala hai chaadar kahin jali hai
<<MINI>>
AmmatTeri Kamaai jangal me lut gayi hai
author: Zaki Bilgrami
